relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: Western blot analysis revealed that EA treatment significantly decreased the overexpression of P2X3 protein in the ipsilateral DRG of CCD model rats compared with the CCD group (Fig. 7a).

relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: Immunofluorescence further analysis revealed that EA therapy significantly reduced the overexpression of P2X3, IB4, and TRPV1 in the ipsilateral DRG of CCD model rats compared to CCD (Figs. 7, 8).

relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: Immunostaining revealed that EA intervention resulted in a marked decrease in SP and CGRP expression in the ipsilateral DRG of CCD rats (Figs. 9a–d)

relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: EA intervention significantly reduced the expression of TNF-α and Il-1β in ipsilateral DRG (Figs. 9e–g).

relationships.subject: alpha,beta-methylene ATP
relationships.evidence_quote: Figure 10b shows that after injecting α,β-meATP, EA had a lesser analgesic effect on CCD compared to rats given the vehicle.

key_findings: 2/100 Hz electroacupuncture relieved CCD-induced mechanical allodynia and reduced P2X3, TRPV1, SP, CGRP, TNF-alpha and IL-1beta in ipsilateral DRG.
The P2X3 agonist alpha,beta-meATP attenuated the analgesic effect of EA.
